items.quote: South Florida Tile Installation is a company I highly recommend! They are very professional. Their work was pristine, the estimate was very fairly priced, they arrived on time, and cleaned up after the job. The owner is such a nice guy too! Trust your home with this company! You will be very highly satisfied.

From the estimate to do the work to the finished product, it was 100% a professional job. Kevin gave us written detail of the work to be done and the cost and didn't add any unusual extra costs. He started on time and finished on time.

Kevin did a great work at remodeling my bathroom, and I highly recommend him! He clearly explained the process, gave very helpful recommendations in selecting the material, and always presented several options in the design.
